summary: Phase 5.6b stabilization regression smoke completed. Live backend (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://drain-dispatch.preview.emergentagent.com) is fully healthy. Full pytest suite 159/159 PASS in 243.88s (148 prior baseline + 11 new Phase 5.6b smoke tests). OpenAPI surface = 36 paths (matches spec). Health=200 {status:ok,env:development}. Tester seed is idempotent and is_admin=true on every startup (log: 'Tester account already exists with is_admin=True'). Backend reload-clean, no warnings beyond known starlette/pytest deprecation notes. Frontend smoke skipped per request (testing_type=backend only).
critical_code_review_comments: Phase 5.6b cleanup verified: top imports in /app/backend/server.py (1-35) are clean, no random/hashlib/bcrypt/jwt leftovers visible from API behavior (auth still uses passlib bcrypt internally inside app/auth modules — confirmed by /api/auth/login still hashing correctly).
TESTER_PASSWORD env-var loader (constants.py 52-66) working: tester@orbus.test still logs in with password123 fallback because TESTER_PASSWORD is not set in /app/backend/.env (intended dev fallback).

/api/admin/classes accumulates test-created classes across CI/dev runs because nothing prunes them. Not a regression (pre-existing) but worth scheduling a cleanup job. The public /api/adventurer-classes endpoint correctly returns the 5 seeded classes.
/api/auth/me response is wrapped as {"user": {...}}; consumers (FE + tests) should respect that shape — not changed in 5.6b but recorded for next agents.
/api/recruitment/candidates returns candidate_id (not id) per candidate; consistent with current FE Recruitment.jsx skeleton keys fix — no action needed.
test_credentials: tester@orbus.test / password123 (seeded idempotently in dev; is_admin=true forced on every startup)
seed_data_creation: Pytest created the usual ephemeral test users/guilds/adventurers as part of the regression run. No additional manual seeding required. Phase 5.6b smoke test reuses the seeded tester and creates one guild only if /api/guilds/me returns 404.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5.6b stabilization is GREEN end-to-end. Backend cleanup (env-var TESTER_PASSWORD, removed unused imports, stable React keys) introduced ZERO regressions. To rerun: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q (takes ~4 minutes, 159 tests). Phase 5.6b dedicated smoke file is /app/backend/tests/backend_phase56b_smoke_test.py (11 tests, ~2s). FE not retested because only cosmetic React key changes were made — main agent may self-check by loading /recruitment and /admin in the browser to confirm no 'each child should have a unique key' warnings.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Initial 4 failed assertions in the new smoke test were due to test-script assumptions about response shapes, not backend behavior; corrected and now all green.
